historicalGeometryOpportunity.description:
Offline geometric opportunity census; this does not create renderable meshes.

All coordinates, material flags and uniform corner RGB/light remain exact.
Cross-cell statistics deliberately relax ownership and need shader/range work.
No coarse-volume resampling or FPS estimate is performed.
